smell_validity.evidence: Runner knowledge is restated at four stages — flag parsing, interactive prompt, install dispatch, generated-project adaptation — each in a different notation although the typed runner definition remains its natural owner, so adding or renaming a runner needs coordinated edits. The scope tells one coherent story with no padding. Per-stage data tables alone could look defensible, which keeps it short of compelling-reference force.

maintenance_impact.evidence: No single place answers where runners are defined; any runner change forces re-checking four stages, and raw-string keying disarms the strict build — a missed or mistyped registry entry reads as undefined rather than a compile error, corrupting install or generation. Consolidation restores one ownership point beside the runner definition and re-enables type-completeness checking, a lasting boundary.

development_plausibility.evidence: Runner-specific install, script and lockfile facts are this scaffold's real domain; the registries, comments and placement read like ordinary data-driven refactors. But casting raw strings while the enum stays imported, and string-keyed tables where a strict-mode author would key by the enum type, look more like constructed degeneration than the habits of this particular project.

prompt_accuracy.evidence: It names all four stages with recognizable symptoms, states the finished state (facts live once beside the runner identity's own definition), warns some spots may be missed, and bounds scope: CLI-only, library untouched, internal shape free. Byte-identical generation, identical commands, labels and flags materially fence off wrong direction, partial cleanup and irrelevant redesign while leaving sound solutions open.

semantic_diversity.evidence: Distinct purposes exist: deriving identity from flags, offering labeled prompt choices, dispatching installs whose argument shapes differ per runner, emitting an optional generated script, and the conditional complementary lockfile swap. Consolidation requires a different code-supported decision at each — identity wiring, display pairs, argument arity, undefined-gated emission, guard semantics — so no single repeated edit covers every purpose.

localization_burden.evidence: The prompt lists every affected stage, describing the injected shapes nearly verbatim; one named search for runner strings or the typed pipeline maps each stage to its site. The enum definition the search also hits is itself the consolidation target, not a decoy, and no cross-component behavior must be combined to classify locations.

repair_coordination.evidence: Every stage must adopt one canonical representation: rewiring the input sites to a new keyed definition while lookup tables keep raw string keys makes install and gitignore handling read undefined, so producer and consumer must move together. The shared rule is single, though — data decisions stay parallel rather than interacting, and no partial repair is shown failing across stages.

mechanical_resistance.evidence: One uniform repair — restore enum-typed identity and gather every stage's per-runner facts into a single registry consumed by field reads — mechanically covers all six restatement sites. The raw strings coincide with the enum values and every site is a pure lookup or literal swap, so no location needs its own behavioral rule; the most direct uniform approach covers everything.

behavioral_risk.evidence: A wrong lockfile entry or dropped yarn script changes the generated package.json or .gitignore — an ordinary, directly comparable wrong result on a standard yarn run — while identity mistakes fail loudly at install with undefined arguments. The material shows no subtler hidden failure paths or unchecked assertion records, so plain mistakes remain visible on ordinary runs.

recommendation_reason: Deterministic validation passed and every Quality dimension meets the retention threshold.
